ex.zh: 銀行必須保持償付能力以保障客戶的錢。

ex.en: You should ask a solicitor to check the contract.
ex.zh: 你應該請律師看一下這份合約。

ex.en: The solicitor handled the sale of our house.
ex.zh: 律師處理了我們房子的買賣手續。

ex.en: All the tickets sold out in an hour.
ex.zh: 票不到一個小時就賣光了。

ex.en: The custard buns are sold out today.
ex.zh: 今天的奶黃包賣完了。

ex.en: If it’s sold out, then just forget it.
ex.zh: 要是賣完了，那就算了。

ex.en: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.
ex.zh: 那些葡萄看起來很甜，但其實是酸的。

ex.en: This orange is too sour.
ex.zh: 這顆柳丁太酸了。

ex.en: I will eat sweet and sour spareribs tonight.
ex.zh: 今天晚上吃糖醋排骨。

ex.en: Their friendship soured after the argument.
ex.zh: 吵架之後他們的友誼就變質了。

ex.en: Relations between the two countries have soured.
ex.zh: 兩國的關係惡化了。

ex.en: Do you have a fever and a sore throat?
ex.zh: 你有發燒和喉嚨痛嗎？

ex.en: I had sore legs the next day.
ex.zh: 隔天我的腿很痠。

ex.en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
ex.zh: 你打到我手臂的地方超痛的。

ex.en: Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.
ex.zh: 媽媽把藥塗在我膝蓋的傷口上。

ex.en: He has a cold sore on his lip.
ex.zh: 他嘴唇上長了一個唇皰疹。

ex.en: We would like to buy a sofa.
ex.zh: 我們想買張沙發。

ex.en: This sofa can seat three people easily.
ex.zh: 這張沙發坐三個人綽綽有餘。

ex.en: Somebody has been sleeping on this sofa.
ex.zh: 有人在這張沙發上睡過。

ex.en: The technician soldered the wires onto the circuit board.
ex.zh: 技師把電線焊接到電路板上。

ex.en: You need a hot iron to solder metal pieces together.
ex.zh: 要把金屬片焊接在一起，需要一支燒熱的烙鐵。

ex.en: The pipes were joined with lead-free solder.
ex.zh: 這些管子是用無鉛焊料接合的。

ex.en: He melted some solder to fix the broken wire.
ex.zh: 他熔化了一些焊錫來修好斷掉的電線。

ex.en: The loss of his mother brought him sorrow and regret.
ex.zh: 他母親的離世帶給他悲傷和遺憾。

ex.en: No words can relieve her deep sorrow.
ex.zh: 語言不能減輕她的悲痛。

ex.en: We didn't notice her sorrow.
ex.zh: 我們沒注意到她的悲傷。

ex.en: He likes to spend some time in solitude every day.
ex.zh: 他喜歡每天都享受一下一個人的時間。

ex.en: The writer moved to a cabin in the mountains to enjoy solitude.
ex.zh: 那位作家搬到山中小屋，享受獨處的時光。

ex.en: I was as sober as a judge.
ex.zh: 我當時非常清醒。

ex.en: I was very sober at the time.
ex.zh: 我當時非常清醒。

ex.en: Who is sober enough to drive us home?
ex.zh: 誰清醒得足以開車送我們回家？

ex.en: The news gave us a sober reminder of the risks.
ex.zh: 這則新聞讓我們嚴肅地意識到風險。

ex.en: He wore a sober dark suit to the funeral.
ex.zh: 他穿了一套樸素的深色西裝出席葬禮。

ex.en: The rain soaked me on my way home.
ex.zh: 我回家路上被雨淋得溼透了。

ex.en: He was soaking wet from head to toe.
ex.zh: 他從頭到腳都溼透了。

ex.en: Soak your sore feet in warm water for twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 把痠痛的腳泡在溫水裡二十分鐘。

ex.en: A long soak in a hot bath helps my muscles relax.
ex.zh: 泡個久一點的熱水澡能讓我的肌肉放鬆。

ex.en: Give the beans a good soak before you cook them.
ex.zh: 煮豆子之前先好好泡一下。

ex.en: The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
ex.zh: 那個玩具絨毛摸起來很柔軟，讓人感到舒適。

ex.en: Her soothing voice helped the crying baby fall asleep.
ex.zh: 她輕柔安撫的聲音讓哭鬧的寶寶睡著了。

ex.en: I like a solitary walk.
ex.zh: 我喜歡一個人散步。

ex.en: Bears are solitary animals.
ex.zh: 熊是一種獨居動物。

ex.en: I wish someone would help me with English composition.
ex.zh: 我希望有人能教我英語作文。

ex.en: I know someone who might be able to help.
ex.zh: 我知道有個人可能能幫忙。

ex.en: Someone left a kind note on my desk this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上有人在我桌上留了一張暖心的紙條。

ex.en: She is doing sociological research on young people and social media.
ex.zh: 她正在做關於年輕人與社群媒體的社會學研究。

ex.en: The book looks at family life from a sociological point of view.
ex.zh: 這本書從社會學的角度探討家庭生活。

ex.en: I came to know this from some reliable sources.
ex.zh: 我是從一些可靠的消息來源得知這件事的。

ex.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
ex.zh: 網際網路是極為寶貴的資訊來源。

ex.en: Hand in a bibliography of your sources.
ex.zh: 把你參考資料的書目交上來。

ex.en: I can't locate the source of the problem.
ex.zh: 我找不到問題的根源。

ex.en: His work is a source of pride for him.
ex.zh: 他的工作是他引以為傲的來源。

sourcing.zh: （商品、原料的）採購來源、尋找貨源

ex.en: She is in charge of sourcing materials from Asia.
ex.zh: 她負責從亞洲採購原料。

ex.en: Ethical sourcing is important to our customers.
ex.zh: 合乎道德的採購來源對我們的顧客很重要。

ex.en: The firm received a solicitation for a charity donation.
ex.zh: 公司收到一份慈善捐款募款請求。

ex.en: We do not accept unsolicited sales solicitations.
ex.zh: 我們不接受未經邀請的業務招攬。

ex.en: The sommelier paired the seafood course with a crisp white wine.
ex.zh: 侍酒師為海鮮料理搭配清爽的白酒。

ex.en: Ask the sommelier to recommend a bottle within your budget.
ex.zh: 請侍酒師推薦一瓶符合預算的酒。

ex.en: What souvenir do you think she would like most?
ex.zh: 你覺得她最想要什麼紀念品？

ex.en: He brought back several souvenirs.
ex.zh: 他帶回了一些紀念品。

ex.en: Is there a souvenir shop in the hotel?
ex.zh: 飯店裡有紀念品店嗎？

ex.en: I am certain that we will find a solution.
ex.zh: 我確信我們會找到解決辦法的。

ex.en: The simplest solutions are always the best.
ex.zh: 最簡單的解決方法往往是最好的。

ex.en: There are three solutions to every problem: accept it, change it or leave it.
ex.zh: 世上所有問題都可以用下面三種方式解決：接受，改變，或是乾脆放開。

ex.en: Clean the lens with a saline solution.
ex.zh: 用生理食鹽水清潔鏡片。

ex.en: Dissolve the salt in water to make a solution.
ex.zh: 把鹽溶在水裡做成溶液。
